newsitem.title: USA: Piercing Pagoda says CEO selling shrs.
newsitem.headline: Piercing Pagoda says CEO selling shrs.

text.p: Piercing Pagoda Inc President and Chief Operating Officer John Eureyecko told Reuters on Wednesday that 900,000 of the 1.55 million shares it is offering for sale are being sold by Chairman and CEO Richard Penske and members of his family.
No reason was cited for the sale.
After the deal, the company said Penske will still own about 2.4 million shares, or 40 percent of the company's outstanding stock.
The other 650,000 shares being offered are new shares created by the company, Eureyecko said.
The stock was down 3/4 at 25 in afternoon trading on Wednesday.
